newsitem.title: UK: Haemocell Plc launches healthcare arm.
newsitem.headline: Haemocell Plc launches healthcare arm.

text.p: Haemocell Plc said on Friday it was launching a new division, Haemocell Healthcare, to help market healthcare products for it and partner companies.
The first alliance will be with France's Bio MS to market in Britain Bio's neonatal incubators, blood warmers, oxygen monitors and other equipment, Haemocell said in a statement.

"A new direct sales force has been recruited and trained and Va customer support department, with dedicated information service lines, is now being established at the company's headquarters in Oxford," it said.
The new division will also market Haemocell's patented range of autologous blood systems, which make it possible to recycle a patient's oown blood during an operation.
Haemocell was formed in 1988 to exploit the autologous blood transfusion market. Its business has been based mostly on the blood recycling product.
